description.zh: tr 翻译、dict AI 词典：用本机的本地模型离线翻译，或用自己密钥的 DeepL、微软翻译及 OpenAI 兼容模型服务
description.en: tr translation and dict AI dictionary: offline with a local model on this computer, or with your own DeepL, Microsoft Translator or OpenAI-compatible service key

notes.zh: 卡片上新增“测试连接”按钮（#495，要 Win顺 0.46.0 或更新）：选好服务、填好密钥后点一下，把一个单词 hello 发给所选服务翻译，连上了显示“连接正常”和用时，连不上显示服务给出的原因（密钥不对、模型不存在、本机的模型服务没启动等）。权限不变。
notes.en: A Test connection button on the card (#495, WinShun 0.46.0 or later): with a service and key set, it sends the single word hello to be translated and shows 连接正常 and how long it took, or the reason the service gave (a wrong key, no such model, the local model server not running). Permissions unchanged.
